title: Laboratory Technician, Class-3 (Additional Director, Public Health, Gandhinagar), Laboratory Technician, Class-3 (Additional Director, Medical Services, Gandhinagar), Laboratory Technician, Class-3 (Director, Employees' State Insurance Scheme, Ahmedabad)
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Chemistry / Microbiology / Bio-chemistry / Bio-technology, and a Diploma in Laboratory Technician or Medical Laboratory Technician (or equivalent course) from a recognised institution; basic computer knowledge; adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both.
salary: Rs. 40,800 per month fixed pay for first five years
application_fee: Payment mode: Online only: debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallets; transaction fee payable extra. Last date to pay the fee: 18 December 2026.

title: Constable, Police Sub Inspector, Jail Sipahi, Jailer, Head Constable Driver Mechanic and Motor Transport Supervisor
qualification: Candidates applying for Head Constable Driver Mechanic or Motor Transport Supervisor posts must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination. In addition, they must possess either of the following prescribed technical qualifications: || Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate with one year of apprenticeship from the prescribed Government-recognized industrial training institution. || Three-year apprenticeship certificate in Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme. || A Class 12 qualification alone is not sufficient for Technical Cadre recruitment. Applicants must satisfy the additional trade and apprenticeship requirements specified in their respective advertisements.
salary: Selected Gujarat Police candidates will initially receive fixed monthly remuneration under the applicable contractual appointment conditions. The Lokrakshak and Technical cadres carry a monthly fixed salary of Rs. 26,000, while the PSI Cadre carries Rs. 49,600 per month. || The notifications provide for initial fixed-pay appointments under the applicable Government orders, generally for a five-year contractual period. Regular appointment in the applicable pay scale is subject to satisfactory completion of training, service and other prescribed conditions. || The advertised amounts represent initial consolidated monthly pay rather than guaranteed in-hand salary under a regular pay scale.
age_limit: The age eligibility will be determined as of 16 December 2026. The maximum age limit is 33 years for Lokrakshak and Head Constable Driver Mechanic posts, 35 years for PSI Cadre posts and 36 years for Motor Transport Supervisor posts.
application_fee: General category candidates must pay an examination fee of Rs. 100 along with applicable bank service charges. Eligible EWS, SC, ST, SEBC and ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from paying the prescribed examination fee. || The examination fee must be paid through the online payment facility on the OJAS portal. The last date for fee payment is 19 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. || Candidates liable to pay the examination fee must complete the payment for their valid confirmed applications within the prescribed deadline.
selection_process: GPRB has prescribed different selection procedures for the Lokrakshak, PSI and Technical cadres. The Lokrakshak and PSI cadres begin with qualifying physical tests, while Technical Cadre recruitment begins with a written competitive examination. || Final appointment is subject to the applicable merit, reservation, document verification, medical fitness and service-related requirements.

title: Food Safety Officer (Class-3)
qualification: Master's Degree in Chemistry or a prescribed Degree in Food Technology, Dairy Technology, Biotechnology, Oil Technology, Agricultural Science, Veterinary Science, Biochemistry, Microbiology or Medicine, including recognised equivalent qualifications.
salary: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer Salary 2026 is Rs.40,800 per month on a fixed-pay basis for the first five years. After completing five years of satisfactory service, selected candidates may become eligible for regular appointment under Pay Level 5, with a pay scale of Rs.29,200 to Rs.92,300, subject to applicable Gujarat Government resolutions and the conditions mentioned in the notification. || The notification states that regular appointment after the initial five-year period is subject to satisfactory service, applicable Government resolutions and the outcome of the referenced Supreme Court proceedings.
age_limit: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer age limit is 18 to 37 years under the original recruitment advertisements, calculated as on 10 November 2026. Upper age relaxation is available to eligible women, reserved-category candidates, PwBD applicants and Ex-Servicemen, subject to the applicable maximum age limits. || Note: The application deadline has been extended, but the OJAS screenshot does not specify whether the original age calculation date has changed. Candidates should check the official extension or corrigendum for any modification to the eligibility cut-off.
application_fee: Payment Mode: Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through the OJAS online payment facility. Applicable transaction charges may be additional. || Important: The original advertisements specified 13 November 2026 as the fee-payment deadline. Candidates should confirm the revised payment deadline from the official OJAS fee section because the extended application advertisement list does not display that date.
selection_process: The GSSSB Food Safety Officer Selection Process 2026 includes a competitive objective examination followed by merit-based shortlisting and document verification. The examination will be conducted through the Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) or OMR method. The question paper contains Part A and Part B, with a total of 210 questions carrying 210 marks.

title: Apprentice - Various Trades and Disciplines
qualification: For disciplines not individually listed above, candidates must refer to the qualification table on pages 13 and 14 of the advertisement. Applicants must possess the prescribed minimum qualification from a recognised institution. || Additionally, candidates who have already undergone or are undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act are not eligible. Applicants must not have completed three years after passing the qualifying examination as on 29 November 2026. Candidates with one year or more of training or work experience after the prescribed qualification are not eligible for Technician Apprenticeship.
salary: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend ranging from Rs. 8,200 to Rs. 12,300 , depending on their educational qualification and apprenticeship category. || The apprenticeship training period is 12 months for all trades. ONGC will not provide transportation, boarding or lodging expenses. Apprenticeship engagement does not guarantee regular employment with ONGC.
application_fee: The official ONGC Apprentice notification does not specify an application fee. Candidates must apply through the respective government apprenticeship portal and follow the instructions displayed there.
selection_process: Application Scrutiny:Verification of eligibility, academic qualifications, age and other requirements. || Provisional Merit List:Prepared based on marks in the qualifying examination. || Document Verification:Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates and required supporting documents. || Final Merit List:Prepared after eligibility and document verification, considering applicable reservation provisions. || Engagement Formalities:Selected candidates must complete the required registration, document and medical fitness formalities. || If two candidates have equal merit marks, the older candidate will receive preference. The notification does not prescribe a separate written recruitment examination.

qualification: MBBS / MD / MS / DNB in accordance with NMC/MCI guidelines
salary: Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 1,18,500 (Level 13) + Other Allowances
age_limit: Varies by post - see the table below

title: Deputy Town Planner; Assistant Town Planner
qualification: M.Arch./M.E.(Civil)/B.Arch./B.E.(Civil)/M.Plan/B.Plan from any recognized university, and a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma course in City Planning/Town Planning/Regional Planning from any recognized institute, or membership of the Institute of Town Planners after passing its examination.
last_date: Post Graduate, B.Arch, B.Plan, B.Tech/B.E, M.Arch, M.Plan, PG Diploma
age_limit: Relaxation as per the Government's rules in force from time to time; the age limit must not exceed 45 years.
application_fee: The fee is paid online by debit card, credit card or net banking. Cash, demand draft, Indian postal order or pay order is not accepted, and other bank charges are borne by the applicant. The fee is not refundable after the online application is filed.
selection_process: SMC will prepare a waiting list of candidates who meet the prescribed qualification, to fill the currently vacant posts by direct recruitment. || Considering the number of applications received, the Municipal Commissioner will decide whether written, practical or oral interview stages are held; his decision is final. || The final selection list and waiting list are prepared on the decisions of the Staff Selection Committee under the recruitment rules for each cadre. || Candidates attend any test at the place fixed by the Appointment Authority at their own cost; SMC pays no travel expense. || If candidates have equal merit, the older candidate gets priority; if age is also equal, educational merit decides.

title: Sub Registrar, Assistant Tribal Development Officer, Social Welfare Inspector, Office Superintendent, Office Assistant, Head Clerk, Senior Clerk and Junior Clerk
qualification: The prescribed degree must be obtained from a university established or incorporated under the applicable Central or State legislation, a recognized institution or an institution meeting the relevant University Grants Commission provisions.
salary: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary ranging from Rs. 26,000 to Rs. 49,600 for the first five years , depending on the post.
age_limit: Applicants must be at least 20 years old and not more than 35 years old as on 30 November 2026 , before any applicable upper-age relaxation.
application_fee: The preliminary examination fee is Rs. 500 for unreserved candidates and Rs. 400 for eligible reserved or concession categories . The notification states that examination fees will be refunded to candidates who appear for the examination. || Fee Payment Last Date: 2 December 2026, 11:59 PM. || Payment Mode: Online using Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through OJAS. Additional transaction charges may apply.
selection_process: The recruitment follows a two-stage competitive examination process: a common preliminary examination and separate main examinations for Group-A and Group-B. || Online Application:Candidates register and submit the application through OJAS. || Preliminary Examination:A common 150-mark objective examination is conducted for Group-A and Group-B. || Shortlisting for Mains:Separate Group-A and Group-B eligibility lists are prepared based on preliminary examination performance. || Main Examination:Group-A candidates appear for descriptive papers, while Group-B candidates appear for an objective main examination. || Document Verification:Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational, age, category and other eligibility conditions.
